units.source_text: 这个时候，音乐家库拉巴喀手里紧紧的攥着那篇诗稿，

en.t: At that moment, the musician Kurabakka was clutching that manuscript of poems tightly in his hand,

units.source_text: 不知对谁喊了句：“太好啦！可以作一支优秀的葬曲！”

en.t: he shouted to no one in particular: "Wonderful! This could make an excellent funeral march!"
His voice was so loud that it startled us.
